name: Scamerino Alertinio Design Palette
description: Design tokens and color palette extracted from Scamerino Alertinio mascot for Cyberpomocnik widget and Guardian platform

primary.name: Shark Blue
primary.usage: Main CTA buttons, navbar, mascot accents, primary active states

primary_dark.name: Deep Ocean Blue
primary_dark.usage: Button hover states, dark card headers, active navigation pills

secondary.name: Shield Silver
secondary.usage: Shield borders, neutral card outlines, container dividers

secondary_border.name: Titanium Border
secondary_border.usage: Input field borders, card framing, table lines

warning.name: Siren Amber
warning.usage: Glowing beacon badge, warning banners, pending review tags, urgent signals

success.name: Padlock Gold
success.usage: Padlock emblems, verified safe status, cyber-points, achievement stars

danger.name: Hook Crimson
danger.usage: Phishing detected badges, high-risk scam warnings, block action buttons

surface.name: Ice Surface
surface.usage: Main page background, soft container fills

surface_white.name: Clean White
surface_white.usage: Card surfaces, input boxes, modal overlays, underbelly white

text_dark.name: Navy Slate
text_dark.usage: Headlines, high-contrast body text, deep shadows
